_comment: Integrity expectations for the upstream SpreadsheetBench Verified 400.
The tarball this project uses is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the official release
(sha256 10ef893dd29cb13a..., 14958255 bytes). Nothing here is a local
modification -- the two excluded tasks below ship excluded by upstream.
02_benchmark_data.sh checks these after unpacking. The point is not to
patch anything, it is to notice if a re-download ever differs from what
the reported cells ran against: a changed task count or a dropped
exclusion would move every SpreadsheetBench number without any error.
Effective n is 398: upstream ships 400 and excludes 2 as ungradeable.

exclusions.reason: ignore, initial file already passes verification
exclusions.detail: input.xlsx already satisfies the answer condition, so the task measures nothing: a model that does nothing scores correct.

exclusions.reason: golden has data validation dropdown set to a completely different value
exclusions.detail: the golden workbook disagrees with its own instruction at D9:D12, so no correct edit can match it.
